messages.author: e7a767e08a4b2d14
messages.subject: residuals and link function
parts:
Hi all -

1. I'm using the occupancy fitting function. When requesting the
residuals from the fitted model, am I correct in assuming that these
are the 'deviance' residuals (vs. 'working', 'pearson', or 'response'
residuals) that are typically used in logistic regression?

2. How would one implement the 'occu' fitting function with a probit
or comp log-log link function in lieu of the built in logit link?
Ideally I could pass the link as an additional argument (which hasn't
worked yet) instead of trying to hack the 'occu' function.

Thanks for your help
Patrick

messages.author: 527e14923215b7e4
messages.subject: Re: [unmarked] residuals and link function
parts:
Hi Patrick,

The residuals are simply y - E(y).

Right now it is not possible to specify other link functions, but I will add your feature request to the to-do list.

Cheers,
Richard
